title: GraveKeeper
description: A lightweight and cinematic Minecraft grave plugin that safely stores player items inside protected graves with holograms, particles and automatic recovery support.
body:
GraveKeeper

A modern and lightweight grave plugin for Minecraft survival servers.

When a player dies, a protected grave head appears at the death location and safely stores all items until recovered.

Designed for:

- SMP servers
- Lifesteal servers
- Survival servers
- Private servers

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Features

✔ Protected player graves
✔ Stores full inventory, armor and offhand
✔ Real-time hologram countdown
✔ Cinematic soul particles
✔ Private death coordinate message
✔ Safe item recovery system
✔ Anti item-loss protection
✔ Explosion and lava protection
✔ Server restart safe
✔ Lightweight and optimized
✔ Paper / Purpur 1.21.1+ support

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

How It Works

1. Player dies
2. A grave head appears at the death location
3. Grave stores all items safely
4. Player returns and clicks the grave
5. Inventory restores exactly as before death

If the grave expires, stored items are permanently deleted.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Commands

/grave locate
/grave list
/grave reload
/grave admin remove <player>

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1+
- Paper
- Purpur
- Java 21

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Performance

GraveKeeper is designed to be:

- lightweight
- optimized
- low-lag
- survival friendly

Safe for public SMP servers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Credits

Plugin idea and design by ItsAnshuXD.
